entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay respond to New Zealand First leader and Foreign Minister Winston Peters' criticism of the India free trade agreement | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Peters had said the deal was potentially discriminatory for Indian nationals when compared to other trade agreements, but McClay rejected that.
 
Luxon said Peters "doesn't like free trade agreements", whether it's with China or India. "The bottom line is what we're doing here is nothing unusual," Luxon said.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/680217/prime-minister-downplays-absence-of-foreign-affairs-minister-during-narendra-modi-visit
